mapper.insert: insert into post (content, status, created_at, user_id, uuid, age) values (#{content}, #{status}, #{created_at}, #{user_id}, #{uuid}, #{age})
mapper.select: select id from post where uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.update: update post set content=#{content}, status=#{status}, created_at = #{created_at}, age = #{age} where uuid = #{uuid}
